name: SpeakBack Phone Set
description: Canonical phoneme inventory for SpeakBack content (D-011). 44 broad British English IPA symbols. Phrase content is stored in SBPS; each recogniser gets its own mapping table into SBPS. Multi-character symbols (tʃ, dʒ, iː, aɪ …) are single tokens.

normalisation.note: Silence/pad tokens are dropped and stress/diacritic marks stripped before scoring. Length (ː) is part of SBPS symbols and is never stripped; engines without length distinctions map through their table.

arpabet.note: ARPAbet/CMUdict is US English. AA covers both ɑː and ɒ, and rhotic ER cannot express British non-rhotic vowels, so every mapped phrase needs UK review. Stress digits: AH0→ə, ER0→ə; strip other digits before lookup.

equivalenceCandidates.note: Not used in Phase 1 scoring (unit costs only). Candidate near-equivalents for a later weighted-cost scorer, to be validated by bake-off data.
